subject: Customer proposal: remediation package and credit request (Starmap Health)
messages:
From: Anna Ruiz <anna@starmaphealth.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>, Starmap Health Billing <billing@starmaphealth.com>
Date: 2027-09-20T08:42:00-07:00
Subject: Severe latency window impacted checkout - remediation request

Hi Karthik,

Wanted to flag a serious latency incident we saw overnight that impacted our patient checkout flow. Between 01:10–02:50 UTC on 2027-09-20 we saw a sustained latency spike: ~12% of requests exceeded 1.2s P95 (baseline ~220ms). That translated to ~5% drop in completed checkouts for the window.

Impact: estimated $120k in lost transactions for that day, and several escalations from our ops team. We have the logs attached (incident_report_20270920.pdf) — ops team traced it to tokenization/serving timeouts on the Redwood endpoint.

Given the business impact, we need a remediation proposal that includes financial make-whole and an SLA amendment for repeat incidents. Our initial ask is either: 3 months of service credit OR a one-time credit of $75,000, plus a formal commitment on latency mitigations and an executive-level postmortem.

Please advise next steps and timeline. We are pulling procurement in if needed.

Thanks,
Anna Ruiz
Head of Product Operations, Starmap Health
anna@starmaphealth.com

--
Attachment: incident_report_20270920.pdf (PDF, 1.4MB)

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>
To: Anna Ruiz <anna@starmaphealth.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.ai>, Ops Team <ops@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-09-20T10:15:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Severe latency window impacted checkout - remediation request

Hi Anna — thanks for the write-up and the attached report. I’m really sorry Starmap ran into this. I’ve looped Monica (CS) and our Ops on-call so we can get a clear picture of the root cause and immediate remediation steps.

Immediate next steps from our side:
- Ops will share an initial RCA snippet by EOD PST.
- I’ll draft a remediation package proposal and escalate to leadership for approval.
- If helpful, I can schedule a short sync tomorrow to walk through the numbers.

Can you share a procurement contact for formal credit paperwork if we get to that stage?

Best,
Karthik
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
karthik@redwood.ai

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>
To: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-09-21T09:05:00-07:00
Subject: Exec approval requested: proposed remediation package for Starmap Health (DEAL-8721)

Team — escalating for decision. Starmap reported the incident below (attached incident_report_20270920.pdf). Summary: sustained latency spike during a 100m window, P95 rose to ~1.2s, customer impact on checkout flow; revenue impact estimated ~$120k.

Customer request: 3 months credit OR $75k one-time credit + exec postmortem and SLA guardrails.

My recommendation (commercial/PR balance + hold the relationship):
- Offer A (preferred): 2 months free + $50,000 one-time account credit (applied to next invoice cycles).
- Additional: commit to a technical action plan (prefix/KV cache improvements, increased dedicated capacity for peak windows) and a joint executive postmortem within 10 business days.
- Require: signed addendum to SLA with clarified latency targets and an explicit remediation timeline.

Rationale: 2 months + $50k is material but not precedent-setting for losses >$100k; it keeps procurement moving while protecting margins. Finance estimate hit: ~ $32k net run-rate impact after offsets.

Attachments: proposed_concession_20270921.xlsx (breakdown + accounting impact), starmap_docusign_link.txt (DocuSign template prefilled).

Ask: executive sign-off (Vivek) + legal (Rishi) quick review of SLA addendum so we can present to the customer by EOD tomorrow. If approved, Monica will own comms and DocuSign flow.

Thanks — need a thumbs by 12:30pm PT.

-Karthik
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

--
Attachment: proposed_concession_20270921.xlsx (Excel, 24KB)
Attachment: starmap_docusign_link.txt (text, contains prefilled DocuSign link)

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-09-21T13:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Exec approval requested: proposed remediation package for Starmap Health (DEAL-8721)

Thanks for the context, Karthik. I reviewed the proposed concession and the attached accounting estimate. I approve a limited remediation package with the following constraints: 

Approved concession (one-time):
- One month of service credit (applied to the next billing cycle)
- One-time account credit of $20,000 (to be reflected on the next invoice)

Conditions:
- Legal must sign off on the SLA addendum language before any credit is applied (Rishi, please prioritize).
- This is a one-off exception; include explicit non-precedent language in the DocuSign addendum.
- Customer must accept the postmortem findings and the technical mitigation plan; once accepted, we’ll schedule a joint technical review.
- All credits must be processed through Finance with the accounting code: FIN-CC-2147. Monica, please coordinate with Billing Ops.

If legal flags something material, escalate back to me. Karthik — please inform the customer that we can commit to the above and that we need the addendum signed to proceed.

-Vivek
VP, Sales Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>
To: Anna Ruiz <anna@starmaphealth.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.ai>, Starmap Health Billing <billing@starmaphealth.com>
Date: 2027-09-21T13:52:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Severe latency window impacted checkout - remediation request

Anna — thank you for your patience while we reviewed this. Our executive team has approved the following remediation offer: 

- One month of service credit applied to your next billing cycle.
- One-time account credit of $20,000 applied to the next invoice.

Next steps:
1) Legal will finalize the SLA addendum and we will send a DocuSign for signature (you’ll receive the prefilled link within 24 hours).
2) Once signed, Billing will apply the credit within two invoice cycles (Monica will confirm timing).
3) We will run the joint postmortem and share the technical remediation plan; Ops has already started the prefix cache/scale changes.

Per Vivek, this is a one-off exception and we’ll include non-precedent language in the addendum. I’ll keep you posted on the DocuSign and the postmortem schedule.

Appreciate the partnership — we’ll move quickly to make this right.

Best,
Karthik Iyer
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
karthik@redwood.ai

--
